violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands at the bar warewashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. Person in charge instructed all staff members to wash their hands ONLY at designated hand sinks. Staff properly washed hands.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink at dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge provided paper towels.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw egg stored above cooked beef in 2 door upright cooler at expo
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed raw egg below all ready to eat items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: walk in cooler at 48F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge removed all items from storage in cooler. Establishment has adequate capacity to hold all items at a proper temperature. A follow-up inspection will be completed within 3 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell egg stored above ready to eat bean sprouts in 2 DR prep at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC relocated bean sprouts to other unit protected from raw animal food contamination. EHS provided PIC with raw food storage handout. HUONG VIET RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 11/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed bean sprouts (45-47F), cut cabbage (47-48F) in cooler at server expo; cooked beans (50F) on counter at bar/drink station, rice noodles (52F) in cambro at cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC relocated all items to cold holding units to be cooled back down to 41F or below within a remainder of 4 hours from original preparation time.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths at bar stored on ledge.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloths in chemical sanitizer solution. PIC educated employees on proper wet wiping cloths procedures.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed deli container used to dispense ice at bar; deli containers used as scoop to dispense MSG, salt, sugar; knives stored in between prep units and freezer in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed deli containers from dry goods and knives located in between prep table and freezer.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. Observed no covered trash can in employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Please obtain a covered trash can for employee bathroom.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored on cook line in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC placed drinks in designated storage.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked egg roll in WIC
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC provided accurate marking. HUONG VIET RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoop in ambient water, ice scoop handle in ice bin, knife stored between 2 dr upright freezer and prep table.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed all utensils from storage locations to be properly cleaned and stored.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw chicken stored above raw pork in 2 dr prep; raw chicken stored above raw egg in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC placed all animal meats according to cook temperature.
